channel.title: Channel
channel.description: A channel, private group, or IM channel to send a message to. It can be an encoded ID or a name.

id.title: ID
id.description: The identifier of the Slack message

is_channel.title: Is channel
is_channel.description: Indicates whether a conversation is a channel

is_group.title: Is group
is_group.description: Indicates whether the channel is a private channel

is_im.title: Is IM
is_im.description: Indicates whether the conversation is a direct message between two distinguished individuals or a user and a bot

is_mpim.title: Is MPIM
is_mpim.description: Indicates whether it is a private conversation between multiple users

is_shared.title: Is shared
is_shared.description: Indicates whether the conversation is shared between multiple workspace

is_org_shared.title: Is org shared
is_org_shared.description: Indicates whether a shared channel is shared between workspaces within the same organization

is_ext_shared.title: Is ext shared
is_ext_shared.description: Indicates whether a conversation is part of a shared channel with a remote organization

is_private.title: Is private
is_private.description: Indicates whether the conversation is privileged between two or more members

is_pending_ext_shared.title: Is pending ext shared
is_pending_ext_shared.description: Indicates whether the conversation is ready to become a part of a shared channel

user.title: User
user.description: The user ID that has to be updated

text.title: Text
text.description: A message text that to be send

username.title: Username
username.description: The bot's username. This propety is only applicable when you set the value of As User property to false.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the item such as file

user.description: The user ID that has to be updated

ts.title: Timestamp
ts.description: The timestamp of the message to be updated
